title: ReadKinetic – a free, local-first speed reader for your own books
claim: Show HN: ReadKinetic – a free, local-first speed reader for your own books
why_good: The local-first approach ensures user privacy and data ownership, appealing to a growing market concerned about data security.
value: Subscription services could be offered for advanced features or integrations with e-book platforms, targeting avid readers and educational institutions.
risk: Established reading apps or platforms may integrate similar features, overshadowing ReadKinetic's unique selling points.
